message.content: {"draft":"Add with FP32 intermediates, cast to input dtype. Tune block size per size/dtype to beat torch.compile on small shapes while keeping large shapes fast.","plan":"Allocate contiguous out. Choose BLOCK_SIZE: 128 for n<=8192, 256 for n<=65536, else 1024. Launch 1D grid with mask. Return out.","code_lines":["import torch","import triton","import triton.language as tl","","","@triton.jit","def _add_kernel(x_ptr, y_ptr, out_ptr, n_elements, BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr):","    pid = tl.program_id(axis=0)","    offsets = pid * BLOCK_SIZE + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE)","    mask = offsets < n_elements","    x = tl.load(x_ptr + offsets, mask=mask, other=0.0)","    y = tl.load(y_ptr + offsets, mask=mask, other=0.0)","    s = x.to(tl.float32) + y.to(tl.float32)","    tl.store(out_ptr + offsets, s.to(x_ptr.dtype.element_ty), mask=mask)","","","def run(x: torch.Tensor, y: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:","    assert x.is_cuda and y.is_cuda","    assert x.shape == y.shape","    assert x.dtype in (torch.float32, torch.bfloat16)","    assert x.is_contiguous() and y.is_contiguous()","    out = torch.empty_like(x)","    n = x.numel()","    if n <= 8192:","        BLOCK_SIZE = 128","    elif n <= 65536:","        BLOCK_SIZE = 256","    else:","        BLOCK_SIZE = 1024","    grid = (triton.cdiv(n, BLOCK_SIZE),)","    _add_kernel[grid](x, y, out, n, BLOCK_SIZE=BLOCK_SIZE)","    return out"]}
